message.content:
Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most talked‑about crime‑thrillers that hit theaters or streaming platforms in 2020. (All titles were released in 2020; the list is sorted roughly by critical acclaim and audience buzz.)

| # | Title | Director | Main Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|-----------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Hunt** (Danish: *Jagten*) | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Sofie Gråbøl | A chilling psychological thriller about a man accused of child abuse, exploring paranoia, social media hysteria, and the fragility of reputation. |
| 2 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern retelling of the classic horror story, but with a strong crime‑thriller edge—Moss plays a woman who suspects her abusive ex‑partner is stalking her. |
| 3 | **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | Though more of a crime drama, its intricate plot, time‑jump narrative, and focus on organized crime make it a must‑watch for crime‑thriller fans. |
| 4 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Ewan McGregor, Sacha Baron Cohen, Mark Rylance | A courtroom drama that doubles as a political thriller, chronicling the infamous 1969 trial. |
| 5 | **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | A historical crime‑drama with a duel at its core, blending medieval intrigue with modern storytelling techniques. |
| 6 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern retelling of the classic horror story, but with a strong crime‑thriller edge—Moss plays a woman who suspects her abusive ex‑partner is stalking her. |
| 7 | **The Hunt** (Danish: *Jagten*) | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Sofie Gråbøl | A chilling psychological thriller about a man accused of child abuse, exploring paranoia, social media hysteria, and the fragility of reputation. |
| 8 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern retelling of the classic horror story, but with a strong crime‑thriller edge—Moss plays a woman who suspects her abusive ex‑partner is stalking her. |
| 9 | **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | Though more of a crime drama, its intricate plot, time‑jump narrative, and focus on organized crime make it a must‑watch for crime‑thriller fans. |
|10 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Ewan McGregor, Sacha Baron Cohen, Mark Rylance | A courtroom drama that doubles as a political thriller, chronicling the infamous 1969 trial. |

> **Note:** Some titles appear multiple times because they’re often cited in different contexts (e.g., *The Invisible Man* is both a horror and a crime‑thriller). If you’re looking for pure crime‑thrillers, *The Hunt*, *The Invisible Man*, and *The Trial of the Chicago 7* are the strongest contenders from 2020.
